chunks: And from him, from al-Nadr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

I asked him about the two rak'ahs of Fajr, whether they are before Fajr or after Fajr. He said: 'Before Fajr. Indeed, they are part of the thirteen rak'ahs of the Night Prayer (Salat al-Layl). Do you want to compare? If the obligatory prayer of Ramadan time entered upon you, would you perform voluntary prayer? No. So begin with the obligatory prayer.'

key_terms.رَكْعَتَيِ الْفَجْرِ: The two rak'ahs of Fajr prayer

ai.seo_question: When should the two Sunnah rak'ahs of Fajr be performed: before or after the obligatory F prayer?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) establishes that the two Sunnah rak'ahs of Fajr are performed before the obligatory Fajr prayer, classifying them as part of the thirteen-rak'ah Night Prayer (Salat al-Layl). He employs a practical analogy of Ramadan to illustrate the principle of prioritizing the obligatory duty over voluntary acts once the specific time for the obligation has entered, a nuance critical to Shia fiqh regarding the timing of rawatib prayers.
